meta.name: adversarial-escalation
meta.description: Strategy: Progressive pressure escalation — starts with surface-level challenges and escalates to fundamental assumption attacks based on defender confidence decay.

copy.tagline: 模拟渐进式压力升级，测试防御系统韧性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在安全评估中模拟真实攻击者的逐步升级策略
copy.tagline_en: Simulate progressive pressure escalation to test defense system resilience
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to simulate an attacker's gradual escalation strategy in security assessments

howto.what: Claude会作为辩论架构师，设计从表面到根本的三层攻击阶梯，并依次用批评者角色挑战你的观点。每一轮攻击后评估你的防御韧性，只有通过才会升级到更深的攻击层次，最终生成辩论总结和裁决。
howto.when: 当你要求测试某个观点、进行压力辩论，或需要分析论证的薄弱环节时触发。也可在对话中自然启动，如果你提出的主张被Claude认为值得挑战。

say.text: 开始对我的观点进行对抗辩论
试试看挑战我关于气候变化的论证
say.note: Claude会从表面到根本逐步攻击

say.text: 用辩论压力测试评估我的逻辑
say.note: 各层次攻击后给出韧性评分

howto.what_en: Claude designs a three-level escalation ladder (surface → structural → foundational) and attacks your position sequentially. After each round, your defensive resilience is measured; only if you survive, the next level is triggered. Finally, a debate summary and verdict are produced.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to stress-test a position, engage in adversarial debate, or analyze argument weaknesses. Also can initiate naturally if Claude deems your claim worth challenging.

say_en.text: Start adversarial debate on my position
Challenge my argument about climate change
say_en.note: Escalates from surface to foundational attacks
Tracks resilience scores after each round
